items.title: Bat Peeking from a Mailbox
items.alt: A tiny bat peeks from an open burgundy mailbox, ears upright and wing thumb hooks resting on the lower door edge.
items.description: A tiny bat peeks from an open burgundy mailbox, ears upright and wing thumb hooks resting on the lower door edge. Useful for personal correspondence cards.

items.title: Bat Wrapped in a Scarf
items.alt: A bat perches on a short twig with a wide mustard scarf wrapped around its body, ears free and folded wing tips visible.
items.description: A bat perches on a short twig with a wide mustard scarf wrapped around its body, ears free and folded wing tips visible. Useful for winter vocabulary.

items.title: Two Bats Touching Wing Tips
items.alt: Two cheerful bats face each other in midair, one wing tip from each meeting lightly while their outer wings balance the composition.
items.description: Two cheerful bats face each other in midair, one wing tip from each meeting lightly while their outer wings balance the composition. Useful for friendship greeting cards.
